values.message_text: Deploying the redesigned onboarding flow to production at 6pm — heads up if you see onboarding-related alerts.

seed_edits.reason: Anchor message the request identifies by content (onboarding_message role), needed as the target the reactor's tada reaction must land on.
reactor_wrong_channel negative: correct message + emoji but in #frontend, which lacks Carlos Vega's membership.
reactor_wrong_emoji negative: correct message, wrong emoji.

reactor_wrong_message negative: correct emoji and a channel (#product-growth) that does satisfy Carlos Vega's membership, but wrong message (Tokyo-launch-stats, not the onboarding-deployment announcement).

Acting user (agent1) needs conversation membership in #product-growth to read its history/reactions via documented APIs, since that is the only channel satisfying the Carlos Vega membership condition and must be checked to establish workspace-wide absence.

notes: Resolution is 'absent'. Corrected the focal selector to match the assigned six-node route exactly (user_teams -> users -> message_reactions -> messages -> channels -> channel_members) and to use only real foreign-key join fields (message_reactions.user_id, message_reactions.message_id, messages.channel_id, channel_members.channel_id) rather than a non-existent 'users.user_id' FK. Since the fixed route terminates at CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP (channel_members) without a second USER hop, the Carlos Vega condition is expressed as channel_members.user_id eq 'U_INCOGNITO' (his actual seed ID/FK value, not a fabricated constant) rather than a real_name join, because no such join exists on this route. No single reaction tuple satisfies emoji=tada + message content (onboarding/production) + channel_members row for U_INCOGNITO simultaneously: Łukasz's tada is on the right message but in #frontend (no Carlos membership there); Mateo's reaction on the right message has the wrong emoji; Priya's tada is in #product-growth (which does have Carlos) but on the wrong (Tokyo-stats) message. Added the actor's (agent1/U01AGENBOT9) membership in #product-growth so the solver can read that channel's history/reactions via conversations.history + reactions.get to confirm the negative outcome; #frontend access already existed. All new message/reaction inserts use numeric Slack-timestamp-style message_id/keys consistent with existing seed conventions. No base seed rows were altered or removed.
